description: The full analysis of one completed session, everything the athlete's session page shows: the headline (a best, a threshold outgrown, the shape of the work), every figure in the card's order — training load, peak VO₂ or VDOT, VO₂ demand at the reps, grade-adjusted pace, efficiency against the six-week average, aerobic decoupling, work above FTP, surges, peak powers, heart-rate load — each with its glossary entry, the session piece by piece from the laps (pace or watts, effort against threshold, oxygen demand, gradient, flat-equivalent pace, heart rate, cadence), the sets, and the impact tab: training effect and the change in fitness, fatigue and form, time in zones, the anaerobic reserve (W′ balance), durability (output per heartbeat against the first twenty minutes — the figure only a long session can earn), how it felt (session RPE against the intensity, TRIMP against the work) and the efficiency figures. Use this before commenting on a session; grade_session is the execution grade alone and get_session_streams the raw arrays. Draws a page in the chat — "The session" — so the figures are on screen: refer to what the page shows rather than retyping it, and spend your words on what it means.

athlete_id.description: May be omitted when you coach exactly one athlete.

name: get_session_analysis
